key_insight: TreeC learns understandable residential energy-management strategies with performance competitive with model predictive control and reinforcement learning.
engineering_relevance: Coordinating batteries, heat pumps, EV charging, and photovoltaic systems can lower household energy costs, but implementation costs may outweigh savings.
method: Compare rule-based, optimization, and machine-learning energy management.
Develop TreeC to learn understandable control strategies.
Evaluate methods through simulations and a real-world experiment.
evidence_signal: Three simulation cases and one real-world experiment showed competitive TreeC performance, but both TreeC and model predictive control performed worse on hardware than in simulation.
watch_item: Deployment requires representative training data and reliable real-time inputs; average savings do not yet offset current implementation costs and effort.
paper_title: How to Effectively Manage the Energy in Residential Systems: Development and Comparison of Methods
